purpose: Complete the current-default training-OOF selective-prediction experiment with five operating coverages and an equal-coverage random-rejection control.

selected_uncertainty_policy.interpretation: The uncertainty score is the direct normalized proximity to the frozen decision boundary; it is label-independent and is not a calibrated per-sample error probability.

operating_points.selective_tie_rule: stable mergesort by uncertainty; original source_index order breaks exact ties

random_rejection_control.definition: Uniform random ranking of all OOF samples, accepting the first k samples at each target coverage.
random_rejection_control.summary: mean, median, 2.5th percentile, and 97.5th percentile across random rankings

paired_bootstrap.sampling: resample within true label with replacement, retaining original class counts
paired_bootstrap.random_control_within_each_replicate: one uniform nested random ranking of the resampled observations
paired_bootstrap.multiple_comparison_policy: Report effect sizes and percentile intervals without p-values or significance stars; no multiplicity-adjusted confirmatory claim is made.

supports_difficult_sample_identification: the 95% paired-bootstrap lower bound for random-minus-selective accepted error is above zero at 90% coverage
the selective accepted-error point estimate is below the random-rejection mean at all four partial-coverage operating points
